title: PA National Guard Fly Over Flooded Areas on the Waccamaw River
description: Looking out the various windows of a  CH-47F Chinook helicopter, Pennsylvania National Guard members perform a local aerial orientation and reconnaissance flight ahead of possible search and rescue missions in the Myrtle Beach, South Carolina area.  Pennsylvania sent 28 Guardsmen to South Carolina to assist with Hurricane Florence recovery efforts. They have been performing aerial support for the last week. Sgt. Robert Prigel and Sgt. 1st Class Joseph Cummings of the PA National Guard's Eastern Army Aviation Training Site (EAATS), appear in this video, chronographically.
